generic.Defined scope/population: All unappointed agencies and brokers in the territories flagged below target agent density.
generic.In-scope period: Current recruitment planning cycle using premium and policy counts for the trailing 12 months.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every prospect row carries agency name, state, ZIP territory, estimated writable premium and owner.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: CRM campaign record count equals the ranked white-space model output after exclusions.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: White-space model extract and CRM list saved with build date and model version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Prospects excluded for prior decline or in-flight pipeline are listed with the exclusion reason.
generic.Test population: The full CRM target prospect list for the cycle, not a sample of territories.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any record lacks territory, estimated premium or an assigned owner.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous or duplicate prospects route to the Agency Relations Manager for adjudication.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: List is accepted when ranked, capped at target count and fully owned by territory.
generic.Evidence location: CRM campaign record plus the white-space model extract in the BI reporting platform.

steps.title: Extract appointed-producer footprint from the agency/producer management system
sop: Run the appointed-producer extract by state and line of business from the producer management system.
Confirm the extract as-at date and record the row count as the footprint control total.
Done when the footprint extract is saved with as-at date and row count.
verify: Compare extract row count to the active appointment count in the producer management system.
Pass when the two counts agree and the as-at date is the run date.

steps.title: Load the footprint into the white-space model in the BI/reporting platform
sop: Load the appointed-producer footprint into the white-space model dataset in the BI platform.
Confirm every state and line code maps to a model dimension with no unmapped rows.
Done when the model loads with zero unmapped state or line codes.
verify: Review the load log for rejected rows and unmapped dimension members.
Pass when the load log shows zero rejects and zero unmapped codes.

steps.title: Overlay premium and policy count by ZIP territory in the BI/reporting platform
sop: Join written premium and policy count by ZIP territory onto the appointed footprint.
Flag every territory whose agent density falls below the published target density.
Done when each ZIP territory carries a density value and a below-target flag.
verify: Reconcile total overlaid premium to the BI platform premium report for the same period.
Pass when the overlaid premium total equals the source premium report.

steps.title: Apply exclusion rules against the agency/producer management system
sop: Remove agencies with an active appointment record in the producer management system.
Remove agencies in-flight in the CRM pipeline or declined within the last 24 months.
Log each exclusion with its reason code against the candidate record.
Done when every excluded candidate carries an exclusion reason code.
verify: Sample the remaining candidates against active appointment records by FEIN.
Pass when no remaining candidate matches an active appointment record.

steps.title: Rank and cap the prospect list in the BI/reporting platform
sop: Score each remaining prospect on estimated writable premium and underwriting appetite match.
Sort descending on the combined score and cut the list at the agreed target count.
Done when the ranked list is capped at the agreed target count.
verify: Check the record count of the capped list against the agreed target count.
Pass when the capped count equals the agreed target and ranking is monotonic.

steps.title: Publish the target prospect list as a CRM campaign
sop: Create the dated CRM campaign and load the ranked prospect records into it.
Assign a territory and a named owner to every prospect record in the campaign.
Done when the CRM campaign holds every ranked prospect with owner and territory.
verify: Run a CRM report on campaign members with blank owner, territory or estimated premium.
Pass when that report returns zero records.

steps.title: Review and accept the prospect list with distribution leadership
sop: Walk the ranked list and territory coverage with the Agency Relations Manager.
Confirm the exclusions and the cap are consistent with the recruitment plan.
Record acceptance and the accepted list version on the CRM campaign record.
Done when the campaign record shows a dated acceptance and list version.
verify: Confirm the acceptance note names the reviewer and the list version.
Pass when acceptance is recorded against the exact published list version.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full agency application package for the prospect under consideration for appointment.
generic.In-scope period: Financial statements covering two years ending within the last 12 months.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: FEIN, legal entity name, DBA, principal names and E&O limits are complete on the application.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Owner count on the ownership chart equals the principal count on the application form.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Every package item is filed in the document repository with received date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing or expired package items are logged as open items with a chase date.
generic.Test population: All required package items for the prospect: application, financials, ownership chart, E&O certificate.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any required item is absent, unsigned or expired at the check date.
generic.Exception handling path: Incomplete packages return to the prospect with a written list of outstanding items.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Package status is set Complete only when every required item is present and in force.
generic.Evidence location: Prospect record in the document management repository linked from the CRM record.

steps.title: Validate the signed agency application form in the CRM prospect record
sop: Open the submitted agency application and check the signature block is complete and dated.
Confirm FEIN, legal entity name, DBA and every principal name are populated.
Done when the application form is confirmed signed and fully populated.
verify: Re-read the FEIN and legal name against the ownership documents supplied.
Pass when FEIN and legal name agree across application and ownership documents.

steps.title: Collect two years of agency financial statements into the document repository
sop: Request and receive the two most recent annual financial statements from the agency.
Confirm the latest reporting period ends within the last 12 months.
File both statements to the prospect folder in the document repository.
Done when two in-date financial statements are filed to the prospect folder.
verify: Check the period-end date on the most recent statement against today.
Pass when the latest period end is within 12 months of the check date.

steps.title: Capture the ownership structure chart in the agency/producer management system
sop: Obtain the ownership structure chart showing all entities and individual owners.
Record every owner holding 10 percent or greater interest on the prospect record.
Done when all 10 percent or greater owners are recorded on the prospect record.
verify: Sum the recorded ownership percentages across the captured owners.
Pass when the ownership chart accounts for 100 percent of the entity.

steps.title: Validate the E&O certificate against carrier minimums
sop: Confirm the E&O certificate names the applying agency as the insured.
Confirm the policy is in force today and the limits meet or exceed the carrier minimum.
Record the E&O expiry date on the prospect record.
Done when E&O insured name, in-force status and limits are confirmed and dated.
verify: Compare the certificate limits to the published carrier minimum for the segment.
Pass when per-claim and aggregate limits both meet or exceed the minimum.

steps.title: Index the package to the prospect record in the document repository
sop: Attach every collected item to the prospect record with document type and received date.
Link the repository folder from the CRM prospect record so it is retrievable.
Done when all package items are indexed and linked from the CRM record.
verify: Open the CRM link and list the attached document types against the required list.
Pass when every required document type is present in the repository folder.

steps.title: Log outstanding items and set the package status
sop: Log every missing or expired item as an open item with a chase date and owner.
Set the application package status to Complete only when no open item remains.
Done when package status reflects the true state of the open item list.
verify: Check that no open item exists on a package marked Complete.
Pass when Complete status coexists with zero open items.

steps.title: Review the completed package before selection
sop: Review each package item for legibility, currency and consistency with the application.
Challenge any document dated outside the acceptable window and return it for replacement.
Record the package review outcome on the CRM prospect record.
Done when a dated package review outcome is recorded on the prospect record.
verify: Confirm no filed document carries an expiration date earlier than today.
Pass when every dated document in the package is in force at review.

generic.Defined scope/population: The single prospect agency scheduled for the introductory recruitment discovery meeting.
generic.In-scope period: Book-of-business figures for the trailing year and growth intent for the next three years.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Meeting date, attendees, premium, line mix, carrier relationships and growth intent are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Line-of-business premium split sums to the stated total written premium.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Discovery notes are logged as a dated CRM activity within one business day.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Disclosed regulatory action or prior for-cause termination is logged for compliance follow-up.
generic.Test population: The discovery meeting activity record for the prospect on the CRM record.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the activity lacks date, attendees or book-of-business profile notes.
generic.Exception handling path: Adverse disclosures route immediately to the Producer Compliance Manager screening step.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Meeting is complete when profile, growth intent and disclosure questions are all recorded.
generic.Evidence location: CRM prospect record discovery activity with attached meeting notes.

steps.title: Schedule the discovery meeting via Microsoft Teams and confirm in CRM
sop: Agree a date with the agency principal and issue the Teams invitation.
Log the scheduled date, attendee list and location on the CRM prospect record.
Done when the CRM record shows the confirmed date and attendee list.
verify: Check that the invite acceptance is received from the agency principal.
Pass when the principal has accepted and the CRM date matches the invite.

steps.title: Prepare the discovery agenda and prospect brief in CRM
sop: Pull the prospect white-space rationale and territory data from the CRM record.
Build the agenda covering book profile, growth intent, carriers and disclosures.
Done when the agenda and prospect brief are attached to the CRM record.
verify: Check the agenda covers every mandatory discovery topic.
Pass when all mandatory topics appear on the attached agenda.

steps.title: Capture the book-of-business profile during the meeting
sop: Record total written premium, line-of-business mix and average account size.
Record the top carrier relationships and the share of book held with each.
Done when premium, line mix, average account size and carriers are captured.
verify: Add the line-of-business premium splits and compare to stated total premium.
Pass when the line splits sum to the stated total written premium.

steps.title: Record three-year growth intent in the discovery notes
sop: Ask for planned premium growth, producer headcount plans and target segments.
Record each answer in the discovery notes with the year it applies to.
Done when growth intent, headcount and target segments are recorded by year.
verify: Check the growth intent notes name specific segments rather than generic ambition.
Pass when each growth statement names a segment and a period.

steps.title: Ask and record the regulatory and prior-carrier disclosure questions
sop: Ask about open regulatory action, prior carrier termination for cause and open E&O claims.
Record each answer verbatim in the discovery notes with the date asked.
Raise a compliance follow-up item for every affirmative answer.
Done when all three disclosure questions carry a recorded answer.
verify: Check that each affirmative disclosure has a linked compliance follow-up item.
Pass when no affirmative disclosure is left without a follow-up item.

steps.title: Log the discovery summary and next steps in CRM
sop: Write the discovery call summary onto the CRM prospect record as a dated activity.
Create next-step tasks with owners and due dates from the meeting outcome.
Complete the logging within one business day of the meeting.
Done when the dated summary and next-step tasks exist on the CRM record.
verify: Compare the activity log date to the meeting date on the CRM record.
Pass when the summary is logged within one business day of the meeting.

generic.Defined scope/population: The prospect contacts entitled to the next-steps notification at the current pipeline stage.
generic.In-scope period: The current recruitment decision cycle for this prospect record.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Recipient address, stage-correct template, outstanding items and response dates are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Outstanding items listed in the notice equal the open items on the prospect record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The sent copy is attached to the CRM prospect record with a send timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Bounced or undelivered notifications are logged and re-sent to a verified address.
generic.Test population: All next-steps notifications issued for the prospect in the current cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if no timestamped sent copy or no follow-up task exists after sending.
generic.Exception handling path: Address mismatches route to the Agency Relations Manager before any send.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notification is accepted when sent, filed and paired with an open follow-up task.
generic.Evidence location: CRM prospect record activity feed with the attached sent notification.

steps.title: Determine the prospect stage and select the approved template
sop: Read the current pipeline stage from the CRM prospect record.
Select the approved advance, pending-information or decline template for that stage.
Done when the stage-correct approved template is selected.
verify: Compare the chosen template name to the stage on the prospect record.
Pass when the template matches the recorded prospect stage.

steps.title: Verify the recipient address against the CRM principal contact
sop: Open the principal contact on the CRM prospect record and read the email address.
Match the intended recipient address character by character to that contact.
Done when the recipient address matches the CRM principal contact exactly.
verify: Re-check the recipient domain against the agency domain on the application.
Pass when recipient address and CRM principal contact agree.

steps.title: List the outstanding items and dates in the notification body
sop: Pull the open item list from the prospect record in CRM.
State each outstanding item and the date by which it is required in the body.
Done when every open item appears in the body with a required-by date.
verify: Count items in the notification against open items on the prospect record.
Pass when the two counts agree with no unlisted open item.

steps.title: Obtain manager review before issuing a decline notification
sop: Review the draft notification content and the stated outstanding items.
Confirm the decline reason wording matches the recorded decision rationale.
Record approval to send on the CRM prospect record.
Done when approval to send is recorded on the prospect record.
verify: Check the approval note names the reviewer and the draft version approved.
Pass when the approved draft is the version queued for send.

steps.title: Send the notification and attach the sent copy in CRM
sop: Send the notification from the marketing automation platform or email as configured.
Attach the sent copy to the CRM prospect record with the send timestamp.
Done when the timestamped sent copy is attached to the prospect record.
verify: Confirm the delivery receipt or platform send status shows delivered.
Pass when the platform reports delivered and the copy is attached.

steps.title: Set the follow-up task on the stated response deadline
sop: Create a CRM follow-up task dated to the response deadline in the notification.
Assign the task to the prospect owner and link it to the sent notification.
Done when an open follow-up task exists dated to the stated deadline.
verify: Compare the follow-up task due date to the deadline stated in the notice.
Pass when the task due date equals the stated response deadline.

generic.Defined scope/population: One appointment recommendation memo covering the prospect agency and its requested authority.
generic.In-scope period: Screening and fit results current as at the memo drafting date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Legal name, FEIN, territory, requested lines, fit score and screening outcomes are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: States and lines in the memo match the states and lines on the prospect record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The memo is attached to the prospect record with draft version and date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every requested deviation is recorded with justification and intended approver.
generic.Test population: The drafted recommendation memo and its supporting screening evidence set.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any supporting screening result is missing or unresolved at submission.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved screening findings return the memo to draft until cleared or referred.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Memo is Pending Approval only with complete background, watchlist and E&O outcomes.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository memo attached to the CRM prospect record.

steps.title: Populate the memo template from the agency/producer management system
sop: Open the current appointment recommendation memo template from the repository.
Populate agency legal name, FEIN, territory and requested lines of authority from the prospect record.
Done when all identity and authority fields are populated from source records.
verify: Compare memo FEIN and legal name against the producer management system record.
Pass when memo identity fields match the system record exactly.

steps.title: Summarise fit score and premium projection from CRM
sop: Pull the recorded fit score, model version and projected written premium from CRM.
Summarise the three-year loss-ratio history and the states and lines requested.
Done when fit score, premium projection and loss-ratio history are in the memo.
verify: Cross-check the memo fit score against the score stored on the CRM record.
Pass when memo score and model version match the CRM values.

steps.title: State the screening and E&O outcomes with completion dates
sop: Record the background-check outcome and the date it completed.
Record the watchlist screening outcome and the E&O validation outcome with dates.
Done when all three outcomes appear with their completion dates.
verify: Trace each stated outcome to its evidence document on the producer file.
Pass when every stated outcome has a matching evidence document.

steps.title: Record requested exceptions and justifications
sop: List every requested deviation such as commission, authority level or minimum premium waiver.
State the business justification and the expected financial impact for each.
Done when each requested exception carries a written justification.
verify: Check each exception names the approving authority level required.
Pass when every exception states its required approval level.

steps.title: Review the draft memo with distribution operations
sop: Review the memo for completeness against the recommendation checklist.
Challenge any figure not traceable to the application package or a carrier reference.
Record review comments and the accepted draft version on the prospect record.
Done when the review outcome and accepted version are recorded.
verify: Confirm no unresolved review comment remains on the accepted version.
Pass when all review comments are closed on the accepted draft.

steps.title: Attach the memo and set status Pending Approval
sop: Attach the final memo to the prospect record in the document repository.
Set the memo status to Pending Approval and record the submission date.
Done when the memo is attached and its status is Pending Approval.
verify: Check that no supporting screening result is missing or unresolved.
Pass when the memo is Pending Approval with all screenings resolved.

generic.Defined scope/population: The prospect record whose appointment selection decision has been approved or declined.
generic.In-scope period: The decision date and the approval window recorded on the recommendation memo.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Decision status, approval date, approver name and memo reference are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Approved states and lines equal the states and lines on the signed memo.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The system audit trail records the recording user and the save timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Declines carry a standardised reason code and a re-approach eligibility date.
generic.Test population: All selection decisions recorded in the distribution system for the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any approved record has a blank approver or blank decision date.
generic.Exception handling path: Mismatches between memo and system authority route back for correction before save.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Decision recording is accepted when status, approver, date and memo reference all exist.
generic.Evidence location: Prospect decision fields and audit trail in the agency/producer management system.

steps.title: Open the prospect record in the agency/producer management system
sop: Locate the prospect by FEIN in the distribution management system.
Confirm the record matches the signed recommendation memo entity.
Done when the correct prospect record is open and confirmed.
verify: Compare the record FEIN and legal name to the signed memo.
Pass when record identity matches the memo identity.

steps.title: Set the decision status in Duck Creek Distribution
sop: Set the decision status field to Approved or Declined per the signed memo.
Confirm no other decision status remains active on the record.
Done when a single decision status is set on the prospect record.
verify: Re-open the record and read back the saved decision status.
Pass when the saved status equals the memo decision.

steps.title: Key the approval date, approver and memo reference
sop: Enter the approval date and the approver name exactly as signed on the memo.
Enter the recommendation memo reference identifier into the decision fields.
Done when approval date, approver and memo reference are all keyed.
verify: Compare keyed approver and date to the memo signature block.
Pass when keyed values match the memo signature block.

steps.title: Record the approved lines of authority and states
sop: Enter each approved line of authority exactly as stated on the signed memo.
Enter each approved state and reject any state not on the memo.
Done when approved lines and states equal the memo scope.
verify: Compare the saved state and line list against the memo line by line.
Pass when the saved scope matches the memo scope with no additions.

steps.title: Record decline reason code and re-approach date where declined
sop: For declines select the standardised decline reason code from the picklist.
Record the re-approach eligibility date per the recruitment policy.
Done when declines carry a reason code and a re-approach date.
verify: Check no decline record carries a free-text reason instead of a code.
Pass when every decline uses a standardised reason code.

steps.title: Save and confirm the audit-trail entry
sop: Save the record and open the audit trail for the prospect.
Confirm the entry shows the recording user and the save timestamp.
Sync the decision back to the CRM prospect record.
Done when the audit entry and the CRM sync are both confirmed.
verify: Compare the CRM decision status to the distribution system status.
Pass when both systems show the same decision and date.

steps.title: Spot-check recorded decisions for completeness
sop: Run the decision completeness report for the recording period.
Identify any approved record with a blank approver or decision date.
Return every incomplete record to the specialist for correction.
Done when the completeness report returns zero incomplete approvals.
verify: Re-run the completeness report after corrections are applied.
Pass when no approved record has a blank approver or decision date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Approved prospect files ready for handoff from recruitment to contracting.
generic.In-scope period: The interval between decision approval and contracting case acknowledgement.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Case links, target contracting date and attached approval evidence are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Attached documents on the contracting case equal the approved package item list.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Contracting case creation and acknowledgement carry timestamps in the workflow tool.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Handoffs blocked by missing evidence are logged with the blocking item and owner.
generic.Test population: All approved prospects routed to contracting in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a recruitment case closes without an acknowledged contracting case.
generic.Exception handling path: Unacknowledged cases escalate to the Distribution Operations Manager after the SLA.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Handoff is complete when the contracting queue acknowledges receipt of the linked case.
generic.Evidence location: Workflow case management tool case record linked to the producer prospect record.

steps.title: Confirm decision status Approved in the agency/producer management system
sop: Open the prospect record and read the decision status and approver.
Stop the handoff if the status is anything other than Approved.
Done when Approved status with a named approver is confirmed.
verify: Re-read the decision date and approver on the prospect record.
Pass when both approver and decision date are populated.

steps.title: Create the contracting case in the workflow/case management tool
sop: Create a contracting case using the producer contracting case type.
Link the case to the producer prospect record identifier.
Done when the contracting case exists and is linked to the prospect record.
verify: Open the case and follow the link back to the prospect record.
Pass when the link resolves to the correct prospect record.

steps.title: Attach the approval and screening evidence to the case
sop: Attach the approved recommendation memo from the document repository.
Attach the application package and the screening result documents.
Done when memo, application package and screening results are attached.
verify: List attachments on the case against the required evidence list.
Pass when every required evidence item is attached.

steps.title: Assign the case to the contracting queue with a target date
sop: Assign the case to the contracting queue in the workflow tool.
Record the target contracting completion date on the case.
Done when the case is queued with a target completion date.
verify: Check the queue assignment and target date on the saved case.
Pass when the case sits in the contracting queue with a target date.

steps.title: Obtain the contracting queue receipt acknowledgement
sop: Request acknowledgement of receipt from the contracting queue owner.
Record the acknowledgement and its timestamp on the contracting case.
Chase daily until the acknowledgement is recorded.
Done when a timestamped acknowledgement is on the contracting case.
verify: Read the acknowledgement entry and its recorded timestamp.
Pass when the acknowledgement is present and timestamped.

steps.title: Close the recruitment case in the workflow tool
sop: Confirm the contracting case is acknowledged before closing recruitment.
Close the recruitment case with a handoff completion note.
Done when the recruitment case is closed with a handoff note.
verify: Check that the closed recruitment case references an acknowledged contracting case.
Pass when no recruitment case is closed without that acknowledgement.

steps.title: Review handoff SLA performance for the period
sop: Run the handoff report showing approval date to contracting acknowledgement date.
Identify handoffs exceeding the agreed SLA and record the delay reason.
Done when every SLA breach carries a recorded delay reason.
verify: Recount open handoffs without acknowledgement past the SLA.
Pass when no unacknowledged handoff sits past SLA without escalation.

generic.Defined scope/population: The agency entity plus every principal holding 10 percent or greater ownership.
generic.In-scope period: Background and reference results obtained within the current appointment assessment.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Legal name, FEIN, principal identifiers and reference contacts are complete and valid.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Background report count equals the entity plus the count of qualifying principals.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each report is filed with its retrieval date and the source data service name.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every adverse hit is logged with its disposition and the reviewing analyst.
generic.Test population: The entity and all qualifying principals on the ownership chart.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any qualifying principal has no background report on file.
generic.Exception handling path: Adverse findings set the file to Referred pending compliance leadership review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Status Cleared is permitted only when no unresolved adverse finding remains.
generic.Evidence location: Producer file in the agency/producer management system with attached report set.

steps.title: Build the check population from the ownership chart
sop: List the agency entity and every principal at 10 percent or greater ownership.
Confirm each principal name and identifier against the application package.
Done when the check population list is complete and confirmed.
verify: Count the listed principals against the ownership chart entries.
Pass when every qualifying owner appears on the check population list.

steps.title: Run entity and principal background checks in LexisNexis Risk
sop: Submit the entity and each principal to LexisNexis Risk for background search.
Capture each returned report with its retrieval timestamp.
Done when a report is returned for the entity and every principal.
verify: Match returned report count to the check population count.
Pass when report count equals the check population count.

steps.title: Verify entity standing against the state corporate registry
sop: Query the state corporate registry for legal entity name and FEIN.
Confirm the entity is in good standing and note the registry status date.
Done when good-standing status and registry date are recorded.
verify: Compare registry legal name and FEIN to the application package values.
Pass when registry identity matches the application identity.

steps.title: Obtain prior-carrier references via Credit Bureau & Data Services contacts
sop: Contact at least two prior appointing carriers named on the application.
Record contact name, date and the substance of each reference given.
Done when two completed references with contact and date are recorded.
verify: Count completed references recorded on the producer file.
Pass when at least two carrier references are recorded with contacts.

steps.title: Review adverse findings and record dispositions
sop: Review criminal, civil judgment, bankruptcy and regulatory results per principal.
Record a disposition and rationale for every hit returned.
Escalate misappropriation or fraud indicators to compliance leadership.
Done when every hit carries a recorded disposition and rationale.
verify: List hits with no recorded disposition on the producer file.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: File the report set and set the background-check status
sop: Attach the full report set to the producer file in the producer management system.
Set the background-check status to Cleared or Referred with the decision date.
Done when the report set is filed and the status is set with a date.
verify: Check that no file marked Cleared carries an unresolved adverse finding.
Pass when Cleared files show zero unresolved adverse findings.

generic.Defined scope/population: The candidate agency being scored against the approved distribution fit-scoring model.
generic.In-scope period: Loss-ratio and premium inputs covering the three years ending at the scoring date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Appetite match, projected premium, loss ratio, carrier count and geographic fit are scored.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The computed total score equals the sum of the individual weighted inputs.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Score, model version and scoring date are stamped on the CRM prospect record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Inputs without a supporting document are logged as estimates with a rationale.
generic.Test population: All scored inputs for the candidate on the current model version.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the stored score lacks a model version or a scoring date.
generic.Exception handling path: Refer-band results route to the Agency Relations Manager for a judgement decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Score is accepted when every input traces to a document or carrier reference.
generic.Evidence location: CRM prospect record scoring fields with the Excel scoring workbook attached.

steps.title: Open the approved fit-scoring model in Microsoft Excel
sop: Retrieve the current approved fit-scoring workbook from the controlled location.
Read the model version and confirm it is the version published for the cycle.
Done when the current approved model version is open and confirmed.
verify: Compare the workbook version to the published current model version.
Pass when the workbook version equals the published version.

steps.title: Stamp the model version on the CRM prospect record
sop: Record the scoring model version on the CRM prospect record before scoring.
Record the scoring date on the same record.
Done when model version and scoring date are stamped on the record.
verify: Read back the stamped version and date on the CRM record.
Pass when both fields are populated and match the workbook.

steps.title: Enter the scored inputs into the model
sop: Enter appetite match, projected premium and three-year loss ratio.
Enter carrier count and geographic fit from the application package.
Done when all five scored inputs are entered into the model.
verify: Check each entered input against the source document value.
Pass when every input equals its source document value.

steps.title: Trace each input to a source document in the producer management system
sop: Record the source document or carrier reference for each scored input.
Flag any input supported only by an unverified producer assertion.
Done when every input carries a named source reference.
verify: List inputs without a source reference on the scoring workbook.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Compute the total score and apply the published bands
sop: Compute the weighted total score in the workbook.
Compare the total against the approve, refer and decline thresholds.
Record the resulting band alongside the total score.
Done when the total score and its band are computed and recorded.
verify: Recompute the weighted sum independently from the input values.
Pass when the recomputed total equals the workbook total.

steps.title: Write the score back to the CRM prospect record
sop: Write the numeric score, band and scoring date onto the CRM prospect record.
Attach the scoring workbook to the record as the supporting evidence.
Done when score, band, date and workbook are on the CRM record.
verify: Open the CRM record and confirm score, band, version and date are present.
Pass when all four values are stored on the prospect record.

steps.title: Review the score and band before selection
sop: Review the scored inputs and challenge any unsupported estimate.
Confirm the band assignment against the published thresholds.
Record the review outcome on the CRM prospect record.
Done when a dated review outcome is recorded on the record.
verify: Confirm the recorded band matches the score against published thresholds.
Pass when band and threshold assignment agree.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every prospect entering qualification screening in the current recruitment pipeline.
generic.In-scope period: Three-year loss-ratio history and current-year appetite matrix at the screening date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Line mix, projected premium, loss ratio and prohibited-class check results are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Screened prospect count equals the pipeline prospect count for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Qualification status is stored with the screening date and appetite matrix version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Out-of-appetite lines and threshold breaches are logged as open flags with owners.
generic.Test population: All prospects screened in the period across every territory.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a prospect carries no qualification status or no driving criterion.
generic.Exception handling path: Flagged prospects hold at screening until the Agency Relations Manager rules on them.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Qualified status requires appetite fit, volume and loss ratio all within thresholds.
generic.Evidence location: CRM prospect record qualification fields with the BI screening extract attached.

steps.title: Check line-of-business mix against the appetite matrix in CRM
sop: Read the prospect line-of-business mix from the CRM prospect record.
Compare each line against the current underwriting appetite matrix.
Flag every line falling outside appetite on the prospect record.
Done when every line is marked in or out of appetite.
verify: Confirm the appetite matrix version used is the current published version.
Pass when the matrix version matches the current publication.

steps.title: Verify projected premium against the territory volume threshold
sop: Pull the projected annual written premium for the prospect from the BI platform.
Compare it to the published minimum volume threshold for the territory.
Done when the premium comparison result is recorded on the record.
verify: Re-read the threshold for the specific territory from the published table.
Pass when the comparison uses the territory-specific threshold.

steps.title: Review three-year loss-ratio history in the BI/reporting platform
sop: Load the agency supplied three-year loss-ratio history into the BI screening view.
Compare each year and the three-year average against the maximum acceptable ratio.
Done when the loss-ratio comparison and its outcome are recorded.
verify: Check the loss-ratio years used cover three complete consecutive years.
Pass when three complete consecutive years are present.

steps.title: Check the book for prohibited classes in the producer management system
sop: Compare the prospect class list against the carrier prohibited class list.
Record any prohibited class present in the book with its premium share.
Done when the prohibited class check result is recorded.
verify: Confirm the prohibited class list version used is current.
Pass when the check cites the current prohibited class list version.

steps.title: Set the qualification status and driving criterion in CRM
sop: Set qualification status to Qualified or Not Qualified on the prospect record.
Record the single criterion that drove the status decision.
Done when status and driving criterion are both recorded.
verify: Run a CRM report on screened prospects with a blank status or criterion.
Pass when that report returns zero records.

steps.title: Hold flagged prospects and adjudicate open flags
sop: Review every open out-of-appetite or loss-ratio flag on the pipeline.
Decide to close the flag, accept with condition, or stop the prospect.
Record the adjudication and rationale on the prospect record.
Done when every open flag carries an adjudication and rationale.
verify: List prospects advanced to selection with an open flag.
Pass when no prospect advances while a flag remains open.

generic.Defined scope/population: The agency legal name, DBA and every named principal submitted to sanctions screening.
generic.In-scope period: Screening run against the list versions published on the screening run date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Names, dates of birth and state list are complete on every screening submission record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Names submitted equal names returned on the screening system response file.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The screening certificate records the OFAC list version and run timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every potential match is adjudicated as true hit or false positive with analyst and date.
generic.Test population: The agency entity, its DBA and all named principals for this appointment.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the certificate omits the list version or any disposition is missing.
generic.Exception handling path: True matches escalate to compliance leadership and stop the appointment.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Status Clear requires zero unresolved true matches across all screened names.
generic.Evidence location: Producer file in the agency/producer management system with the screening certificate.

steps.title: Assemble the screening submission from the producer management system
sop: Extract the agency legal name, DBA and each principal name and date of birth.
Confirm each name matches the application package spelling exactly.
Done when the submission list is assembled and name-checked.
verify: Count submission names against the principals on the ownership chart.
Pass when every principal and the entity appear on the submission list.

steps.title: Submit names to the sanctions screening system
sop: Load the submission into the LexisNexis Bridger or FircoSoft screening system.
Run the screen and capture the response file with its run timestamp.
Done when the screening run completes and the response is captured.
verify: Compare returned name count to submitted name count.
Pass when returned names equal submitted names.

steps.title: Confirm the OFAC and consolidated list versions in use
sop: Read the OFAC SDN and consolidated list versions loaded in the screening system.
Compare them against the currently published list versions.
Done when the loaded list versions are confirmed current.
verify: Check the list publication dates against the screening run date.
Pass when the loaded lists are the latest published at run date.

steps.title: Screen state DOI regulatory action databases via LexisNexis Risk
sop: Screen each principal against state regulatory action and revocation databases.
Cover every state in which the producer intends to be licensed.
Done when each licensed state database has been screened.
verify: List states screened against the requested state list.
Pass when no requested state is missing from the screened list.

steps.title: Adjudicate every potential match
sop: Review each potential match against identifying data on the producer file.
Record true hit or false positive with the analyst name, rationale and date.
Escalate every true hit to compliance leadership immediately.
Done when every potential match carries a recorded adjudication.
verify: List potential matches lacking an adjudication entry.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: File the certificate and set the watchlist screening status
sop: Attach the screening certificate to the producer file with the run timestamp.
Set watchlist screening status to Clear or Escalated on the producer record.
Done when the certificate is filed and the status is set.
verify: Check no prospect proceeds to appointment with an unresolved true match.
Pass when Clear status coexists with zero unresolved true matches.

generic.Defined scope/population: One appointment approval request covering the selected producer and its requested authority.
generic.In-scope period: Screening and fit results current at the submission date and within their validity window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Approval level, submission date, SLA due date and attachment set are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Attached evidence items equal the required approval evidence checklist.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The workflow tool records submitter, submission timestamp and routed approver level.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests submitted with any incomplete screening are rejected and logged with the gap.
generic.Test population: All appointment approval requests submitted in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the routed approval level does not match the authority matrix requirement.
generic.Exception handling path: Requests exceeding standard authority route to the Head of Distribution for decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Submission is valid when screening, background and fit are all complete and cleared.
generic.Evidence location: Workflow case management tool approval request linked to the producer record.

steps.title: Confirm screening and fit completeness on the producer file
sop: Read the fit score, background-check and watchlist statuses on the producer file.
Confirm each status is complete and cleared with no open finding.
Done when all three statuses are confirmed complete and cleared.
verify: List any status that is incomplete, referred or escalated.
Pass when that list is empty before submission.

steps.title: Determine the required approval level from the authority matrix
sop: Read projected written premium and requested binding authority from the memo.
Look up the required approval level in the current authority matrix.
Record the required level on the producer record.
Done when the required approval level is recorded on the record.
verify: Recheck the matrix row using premium and binding authority values.
Pass when the recorded level equals the matrix requirement.

steps.title: Raise the appointment request in the workflow/case management tool
sop: Create the appointment approval request against the producer record.
Route the request to the approver at the required authority level.
Done when the request exists routed to the required approver level.
verify: Read the routed approver level on the submitted request.
Pass when the routed level equals the recorded required level.

steps.title: Attach the memo, certificate and package to the request
sop: Attach the recommendation memo and the screening certificate.
Attach the full application package from the document repository.
Done when all three evidence items are attached to the request.
verify: List attachments against the required approval evidence checklist.
Pass when every checklist item is attached.

steps.title: Record submission date and SLA due date in the producer record
sop: Record the submission date on the producer record in the CRM and producer system.
Calculate and record the approval SLA due date.
Done when submission date and SLA due date are both recorded.
verify: Compare the SLA due date to the published approval SLA duration.
Pass when the due date equals submission date plus the SLA duration.

steps.title: Review and decide the appointment approval request
sop: Review the memo, screening outcomes and requested exceptions.
Approve, decline or return the request with the reason recorded.
Record the decision, date and any conditions on the workflow request.
Done when a dated decision with conditions is recorded on the request.
verify: Confirm no request was decided while a screening status was incomplete.
Pass when every approved request had complete screening at decision.

generic.Defined scope/population: The prospective agency and each named principal checked against the producer master.
generic.In-scope period: All historical appointment records held for the entity regardless of status date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: FEIN and NPN are present and valid for every searched entity and principal.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Search count equals the entity plus principal count on the prospect record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The validation outcome is recorded with the search date on the prospect record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Duplicate or prior-terminated records are merge-flagged with a disposition note.
generic.Test population: The prospective entity plus every named principal on the application.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any searched party has no recorded validation outcome.
generic.Exception handling path: For-cause prior terminations route to the Producer Compliance Manager before selection.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Validation is complete when the outcome is keyed on both FEIN and NPN.
generic.Evidence location: Prospect record in the agency/producer management system with the search results attached.

steps.title: Search the producer master by FEIN in the producer management system
sop: Search the producer master for the FEIN of the prospective agency.
Capture every returned record with its status and effective dates.
Done when the FEIN search results are captured on the prospect record.
verify: Re-run the FEIN search and compare the returned record set.
Pass when both runs return the same record set.

steps.title: Search by NPN in NIPR and the producer master
sop: Search the producer master and NIPR by NPN for the agency and each principal.
Capture any matching producer record identifiers returned.
Done when NPN searches are complete for the entity and all principals.
verify: Count NPN searches performed against the principal list.
Pass when every principal and the entity have an NPN search result.

steps.title: Classify existing appointment records found
sop: Classify each found record as active, terminated or pending appointment.
Record the appointment effective and termination dates for each.
Done when every found record carries a status classification.
verify: Re-read statuses in Duck Creek Distribution for the same records.
Pass when classifications match the Duck Creek record statuses.

steps.title: Retrieve prior termination reasons and check for cause
sop: Retrieve the termination reason for every prior appointment found.
Determine whether any termination was recorded as for cause.
Escalate any for-cause termination before selection proceeds.
Done when every prior termination has a recorded reason and cause flag.
verify: List prior terminations without a recorded reason.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Check for duplicate producer codes under DBA or predecessor names
sop: Search the producer master by DBA and predecessor entity names.
Merge-flag any duplicate producer code found for the same entity.
Done when duplicate checks are complete and any duplicate is merge-flagged.
verify: Confirm no new producer code exists where an active record shares the FEIN.
Pass when the FEIN has at most one active producer code.

steps.title: Record the validation outcome on the prospect record
sop: Record the outcome as No Prior Record, Reinstatement or Duplicate.
Attach the FEIN and NPN search evidence to the prospect record.
Done when the outcome and search evidence are on the prospect record.
verify: Confirm the outcome cites both the FEIN and NPN search results.
Pass when the outcome is keyed on both identifiers.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full executed document set required before the producer can be released for activation.
generic.In-scope period: Documents in force at the agreement effective date and the collection date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Document type, effective date and signature status are populated on every indexed item.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Indexed document count equals the required document checklist count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each item is indexed with its version and the date received into the repository.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing or unsigned items are logged as open items with owner and chase date.
generic.Test population: Agreement, W-9, EFT form, E&O certificate and every state licence copy.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any required signature block is unsigned on a set marked complete.
generic.Exception handling path: Unsigned or missing documents return to the producer with a written request.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The set is complete when every checklist item is indexed and fully signed.
generic.Evidence location: Producer record in OpenText Document Mgmt and the contract lifecycle repository.

steps.title: Verify signatures on the executed producer agreement
sop: Open the executed agreement in the contract lifecycle management repository.
Confirm both the producer principal and the carrier signatory have signed and dated.
Done when both signature blocks are confirmed signed and dated.
verify: Re-inspect each signature block for a name, title and date.
Pass when no required signature block is blank.

steps.title: Collect the W-9, EFT authorisation and E&O certificate
sop: Request and receive the signed W-9 and EFT banking authorisation form.
Receive the current E&O certificate and read its expiry date.
Done when W-9, EFT form and E&O certificate are all received.
verify: Check the E&O expiry date against the intended activation date.
Pass when the E&O policy is in force at the activation date.

steps.title: Collect resident and non-resident licence copies per state
sop: List every state on the agreement territory exhibit.
Collect a resident or non-resident licence copy for each listed state.
Done when a licence copy exists for every state on the exhibit.
verify: Count licence copies against the states on the territory exhibit.
Pass when counts agree with no state missing a copy.

steps.title: Verify the commission schedule exhibit and addenda
sop: Confirm the commission schedule exhibit is attached to the executed agreement.
Confirm every addendum is present and initialled where the template requires.
Done when the exhibit and all addenda are attached and initialled.
verify: Compare attached exhibit rates to the approved recommendation memo rates.
Pass when exhibit rates match the approved memo rates.

steps.title: Index the document set in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Index every item to the producer record with document type and effective date.
Confirm each indexed item is retrievable by producer code.
Done when all items are indexed with type and effective date.
verify: Search the repository by producer code and list returned document types.
Pass when every required document type is returned.

steps.title: Review the assembled set before contracting closure
sop: Review the indexed set against the required document checklist.
Log every missing or unsigned item as an open item with owner and chase date.
Record the completeness review outcome on the producer record.
Done when the review outcome and any open items are recorded.
verify: Check that no set marked complete carries an open item.
Pass when complete status coexists with zero open items.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every state included on the producer appointment submission for this producer.
generic.In-scope period: DOI status as at the confirmation run date following appointment filing.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: State, appointment status and effective date are populated for each state row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Confirmed state count equals the requested state count on the submission.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The NIPR status report is filed with its retrieval timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Pending, rejected or not-found states are logged with a reason code and remediation.
generic.Test population: All states on the appointment request, not a sample.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any requested state lacks an Active status with an effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: Rejected states are re-filed and tracked to acceptance by the compliance manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Confirmation status is set only when every state shows Active at the DOI.
generic.Evidence location: Compliance evidence repository with the DOI report linked to the producer file.

steps.title: Retrieve the NIPR appointment status report per state
sop: Query NIPR for the appointment status of the producer in each submitted state.
Capture the report with its retrieval timestamp.
Done when a status report exists covering every submitted state.
verify: Count report state rows against the submitted state list.
Pass when report rows equal the submitted state count.

steps.title: Confirm Active status and effective date per state
sop: Read the DOI status and effective date for each state row.
Mark each state as confirmed Active or not confirmed.
Done when every state row carries a confirmation mark.
verify: List states marked confirmed without an effective date.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Reconcile the confirmed list to the requested states
sop: Compare the confirmed state list line by line to the requested state list.
Record any requested state absent from the confirmed list.
Done when the reconciliation is complete and variances are recorded.
verify: Recount confirmed states against requested states.
Pass when the counts agree or every variance is recorded.

steps.title: Investigate and re-file pending or rejected states in NIPR
sop: Read the rejection or pending reason code for each unconfirmed state.
Correct the underlying data and re-file the appointment transaction.
Record the re-filing date and new confirmation number.
Done when every unconfirmed state has a re-filing or an open remediation item.
verify: List unconfirmed states without a remediation item.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Attach the DOI status report to the producer file
sop: File the DOI status report in the compliance evidence repository.
Link the filed report to the producer record in the producer management system.
Done when the report is filed and linked to the producer record.
verify: Open the producer record link and confirm the report opens.
Pass when the linked report resolves and shows the retrieval timestamp.

steps.title: Set the appointment confirmation status on the producer record
sop: Set appointment confirmation status to Confirmed where all states are Active.
Leave the status open where any state remains unconfirmed.
Done when the confirmation status reflects the true state coverage.
verify: Check no Confirmed status coexists with a pending or rejected state.
Pass when Confirmed implies every requested state is Active.

generic.Defined scope/population: One new producer master record for the approved and contracted agency entity.
generic.In-scope period: Record created effective from the executed agreement effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Legal name, DBA, FEIN, NPN, producer code and effective date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: One active producer code exists for the FEIN after creation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Record creation carries the creating user and creation timestamp in the audit trail.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Duplicate hits found at creation are logged with the merge or reject disposition.
generic.Test population: The new producer master record and its downstream propagation records.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a second active producer code exists for the same FEIN.
generic.Exception handling path: Duplicate FEIN detections stop creation and route to the operations manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Creation is accepted when the code propagates to the billing platform successfully.
generic.Evidence location: Producer master record in the agency/producer management system and Duck Creek Distribution.

steps.title: Re-run the duplicate check on FEIN and NPN
sop: Search the producer master by FEIN and NPN immediately before creation.
Stop and escalate if any active record is returned.
Done when the duplicate check returns no active record.
verify: Repeat the FEIN search after the check completes.
Pass when no active producer record exists for the FEIN.

steps.title: Create the producer master record with identity data
sop: Create the record with legal entity name, DBA, FEIN and NPN.
Enter the principal contact name, email and phone from the application.
Done when the record exists with identity and contact data populated.
verify: Compare keyed identity fields to the executed agreement.
Pass when identity fields match the executed agreement.

steps.title: Assign the producer code from the controlled sequence
sop: Assign the next producer code from the controlled sequence, never manually.
Record the agreement effective date on the master record.
Done when the producer code and effective date are assigned.
verify: Check the assigned code follows the controlled sequence format.
Pass when the code is sequence-issued and unique.

steps.title: Set producer type, channel and servicing territory
sop: Set producer type and distribution channel on the master record.
Set the servicing branch or territory from the assignment decision.
Done when type, channel and servicing territory are set.
verify: Compare the territory assignment to the recruitment territory record.
Pass when the assigned territory matches the recruitment record.

steps.title: Confirm propagation to the billing/commission platform
sop: Check the billing and commission platform for the new producer code.
Re-trigger the interface if the code has not propagated.
Done when the producer code is visible in the billing platform.
verify: Search the billing platform by producer code and read the record.
Pass when the billing platform returns the new producer code.

steps.title: Review the created record before contracting continues
sop: Review identity, code, effective date and territory on the new record.
Confirm no second active code exists for the same FEIN in Duck Creek.
Record the review sign-off on the producer record.
Done when a dated review sign-off is on the producer record.
verify: Run the duplicate producer code report for the FEIN.
Pass when the report shows exactly one active code.
